messages:
Maria: quick sync - postmortem for last night's cross-region routing jitter is up. root cause: flapping route updates + a cert chain edge case causing intermittent TLS failures and a resolver miss storm. link: https://redwood.internal/pm/17946
Alex: thanks. Can we break remediation into owners? I'll handle DNS cache metrics and resolver warm pool work.
Priya: I can own routing rate-limiter + canary guardrails. Will do a staging run today.
Sam: on TLS - I'll add handshake probes and edge prefetch sketch. Will attach to INF-9130.
infra-bot: Incident INF-9130 created and assigned to eng-routing/eng-sre.
Maria: immediate mitigations (48h): 1) guard canary with pinned pools (Priya) 2) increase client-side TLS retry jitter for 20m (Sam) 3) enable resolver warm pool in eu regions (Alex).
Priya: plan for pinning: prefer local region, enable drain timeout 25s, and limit route-change-per-minute to 2. Running dry-run in staging now.
Sam: probe plan: periodic TLS handshake that fetches full chain, record cert_chain_length and handshake_time_ms. Will add metric tls.handshake_success{region}.
Alex: DNS findings: saw resolver miss spikes aligned with route-change bursts. TTLs unchanged but cache eviction rate spiked. Warm pool reduced misses in staging by ~10%.
Maria: long-term (2-3w): Priya -> leader-elected routing control + rate limiter; Sam -> OCSP stapling + cert prefetch at edge; Alex -> resolver warm pools + jittered revalidation.
Priya: ETA 2w for design + rollout checklist. Deliverables: design doc, rollout playbook, canary cutover steps.
Sam: ETA 3w for TLS prefetch + OCSP changes. Will also add regression test that simulates 512B MTU chain handshake.
Alex: ETA 2w for resolver warm pool and dashboard: dns_cache_hit_ratio, resolver_miss_rate, route_change_rate. Sharing draft dash: https://dash.redwood/internal/d/abc
oncall-bot: Reminder: update INF-9130 status when tasks start/complete.
Maria: owners confirmed: Priya (routing), Sam (TLS), Alex (DNS). Please create project tasks for 48h mitigations and tag @eng-oncall.
Priya: created tasks, linking PRs to INF-9130. Staging run looks clean after dry-run, no 5xx seen in 45m soak.
Sam: probe running, first 30m shows handshake_success eu-west ~99.8%. Posting logs to INF-9130.
Alex: exporting resolver logs now. Will update dashboard and post summary by EOD.
Maria: checkpoint tomorrow 10:30PT to review staging metrics and decide prod rollout. If any blocker, ping #eng-oncall.
Priya: noted, fixing a small canary flag mismatch before prod rollout.
Sam: captured sample error: "tls: remote error: handshake failure (EOF)" - saved for debug.
Alex: after warm pool tweak staging -> dns cache-hit +12%. good sign.
Maria: thanks everyone. Please include regression tests in PRs so we don't regress. Closing thread unless blockers.
